sentences.text: Ms. Sharmila Sharma - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Surendra Kumar Gupta, Ga for respondent/State.

Heard on I.A.No. 2026/2026 which is second application under Section 389(1)Cr.P.C./430 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of sole appellant - Mukesh.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence u/s 342 of IPC for a period of one year RI with a fine of Rs.500/-, u/s 376 (G) of IPC for a period of twenty years of RI with a fine amount of Rs.
2000/- and 506(2) of IPC for a period of one year with a fine amount of Rs 500/- along with a default clause.

Counsel for the appellant argued on the two grounds, firstly that the co-convict has already been granted suspension of sentence in Cr.Appeal No.1099/2017 and secondly, the appellant has completed actual jail sentence of 10 years.
Counsel for the State opposed the application, however he did not dispute the aforesaid submission.
In view of aforesaid, considering the parity and also the incarceration period, we deem
it expedient to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Mukesh shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 14.05.2026, and thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
